about_the_game:
"Light and Shadow Life" is a live-action interactive movie game that combines campus life, romance, and business competition. Players will step into the shoes of the male protagonist, Shen Hao, and experience a roller-coaster ride from hardship to glory. Though surrounded by the deceit and intrigue of business warfare, you are not alone. Friends and lovers walk by your side, lighting the way on your life's journey.

In real life, there's no second chance, but in the game, you can explore all possibilities. Will you turn enemies into friends, or face the world alone? In the end, who will you choose to spend the rest of your life with? Dozens of endings await your exploration.

A Cinematic Feast for the Senses

Filmed with cinematic quality in 1080P/2K resolution, the game offers an immersive experience that will make players feel like they are truly living the story.

Connection to Current Events

Live streaming, e-commerce, stock trading... The game is deeply connected to real-world trends, allowing for an immersive life experience.

Emotional Choices

Love is composed of a single soul inhabiting two bodies

The course of true love never did run smooth.

For every atom belonging to me as good belongs to you.

Showcase Your Business Talents

Navigate the competitive business world and carve out a place for yourself in the industry.

Explore Multiple Endings

Numerous endings await as you make choices throughout the game.

A Message to Players

In recent years, interactive film games have flourished. Our goal is to break away from the monotony of "beauty games" and introduce more themes like business, stocks, and live streaming, while incorporating current social events into the gameplay. We aim to offer players a fresh narrative-driven interactive film experience. Our experienced production team, who worked on hit shows like "Hot and Spicy" and "Northward", has brought their expertise to this project, ensuring a top-tier visual experience. To make the game more interactive, we've added easy-to-play mini-games and hidden plot points waiting to be discovered by players.
